## Notes for the coordinator

- No lane edits a production file; test lanes add new test files. No lane touches workflows, run-all.sh or coverage baselines.
- Newman lanes need a PostgreSQL-backed Nextcloud; the sandbox boot is unverified on PostgreSQL. Each Newman lane probes it and otherwise relies on the PR's CI Newman job, read once.
- Base is main (ADR-122); the development branch is locked read-only since 06:47 UTC on 9 Nov 2026.
